name: Subgroup Orbit Framing
description: Replaces the quadratic penalty and geometric subspace framing with the generation of permutations and orbits in $S_n$. The $n-1$ transpositions generating $S_n$ form a tree, and elements being in the same orbit means they are connected. This mathematically equivalent formulation forces models to translate abstract algebraic generation into graph connectivity without relying on tree-specific terminology.
